mLocKeys.keySummary: Swain inspires dread in his enemies by temporarily taking the form of a raven. During this time ravens strike out at nearby enemies. Each raven deals damage and heals Swain based on the damage dealt.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Toggle: Swain transforms into the form of a raven. During this time, up to @MaxRavens@ lesser ravens strike out at nearby enemies every @TickInterval@ second, prioritizing champions. Each raven deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage and heals Swain for @ChampionHealPercent*100@% of the damage dealt against champions, and @MinionHealPercent*100@% against minions.

The cost to sustain Ravenous Flock increases by @ManaCostInc@ mana every @TickInterval@ second.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Swain sets his raven to cripple an enemy. Over the next few seconds, the target takes damage over time and is slowed.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <mainText>Swain sets his raven to cripple an enemy. Over the next @Duration@ seconds, the target takes <magicDamage>@DamagePerSecond@ magic damage</magicDamage> per second (Max: <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ damage</magicDamage>) and is <status>slowed</status> by @MoveSpeedMod*-100@%.</mainText>
